context: A boss mentors a uni intern
purpose: Teach: 市議会/軽量/しくみ/持ち込み/冊子/薬剤師/値下げ/有識者

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、市議会、地元政治、興味、持て。
lines.en: Ren, I want you to pay attention to city council and local politics.
lines.style: Direct but not unkind. Measured pace. A statement more than a command—the weight of expectation, not force. Slight lean forward on the opening name.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。製品の軽量化、技術、勉強したいです。
lines.en: Yes. I'd like to study product lightweight technology and materials.
lines.style: Careful, respectful cadence. Slight hesitation before the specific technical detail—showing he's thought about this but remains uncertain. Earnest without overshooting.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: Learn how the supply chain works. That's essential.
lines.style: Clipped, purposeful. No flourish. Each phrase lands like a piece on a board. The tone of someone who doesn't repeat himself.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 機密の持ち込み禁止、徹底されてますね。
lines.en: The confidentiality policies are really strictly enforced here, aren't they.
lines.style: Observant, almost conversational. A slight lilt of recognition—noticing the protocol as he moves through it. Respectful but not obsequious.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 就活冊子、企業情報、丁寧に読め。
lines.en: Read through the recruitment materials and company information carefully.
lines.style: Practical instruction, no ornament. Slightly slower on 'carefully'—emphasis on due diligence. The tone of someone who knows what details matter.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 薬剤師の従兄、医療業界、興味深い、と言ってました。
lines.en: My pharmacist cousin mentioned that the medical industry is really interesting.
lines.style: Thoughtful mid-sentence pause. Speaking more to himself than to Hiroshi—genuine curiosity poking through. Soft landing on the observation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 流通の値下げ競争、激しいぞ。
lines.en: The competition in distribution is getting cut-throat.
lines.style: Low-voiced warning. Not alarmist, but weighted. A fact delivered as a pattern Hiroshi has already seen play out. Slight exhale on 'fierce'.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 有識者会議の傍聴、可能ですか。
lines.en: Would it be possible for me to observe one of the expert council meetings?
lines.style: Respectful but direct question. Careful phrasing—he's asking permission but with quiet intent. Slight uptick at the end, genuine inquiry not deference.
